settings_language_hint: Which language this device displays the app in — the assistant replies in whatever language you write.
settings_animations_hint: How animated content (weather panels and more) renders on this device — High drives the GPU; Basic and Off are easy on it.
notifications_sound: Play a sound when the assistant needs my input
files_empty_hint: Browse and manage your files from the sidebar.
tasks_empty_hint: Pick a task from the sidebar, or create one with New task.
appbar_ag2_view_title: AG2 view — reveal the live AG2 events powering the UI
notice_profile_archived_default: Profile {name} was archived — switching to the default profile.
notice_profile_archived_unnamed: This profile was archived — switching to {dest}.
notice_profile_archived_unnamed_default: This profile was archived — switching to the default profile.
drawer_new_profile_lead: A colour-coded, isolated workspace — its own chats, tasks, memory, and files.
onboarding_feature_ag2_desc: A universal agent runtime — the open-source framework behind every reply.
onboarding_feature_acts_desc: Searches the web, runs code, generates images, and manages scheduled tasks.
onboarding_feature_memory_desc: Builds a private memory of your preferences so it gets more helpful over time.
onboarding_hero_lead: A friendly AI assistant that actually does the work — and shows you exactly how, in the open.
onboarding_welcome_lead: Setup takes about a minute. You'll connect a model, create a profile or two, and you're off. Nothing leaves your machine — keys and settings stay local.
onboarding_name_label: First, what should I call you?
onboarding_name_hint: so I can greet you properly
onboarding_about_lead: A few optional details so every profile knows you. Shared across all profiles — helps every profile know you. All optional.
onboarding_style_label: How do you like your answers?
onboarding_connect_lead: Add a provider key — or skip keys entirely and run on a subscription you already have: your ChatGPT login, or the Claude Code / Codex CLI. Whatever you choose is stored locally and shared across all your profiles. You can skip this step and connect later in Settings → Models.
onboarding_oauth_label: Sign in with your ChatGPT subscription
onboarding_oauth_complete: Complete sign-in in the opened tab.
onboarding_oauth_code_placeholder: paste the code from the redirect URL
onboarding_oauth_quota_note: Runs on your ChatGPT Plus/Pro quota. OpenAI doesn't officially support this — your account could be rate-limited.
onboarding_cli_bridge: Reachable through the host ACP bridge
onboarding_cli_ready: Adapter answered — running on your CLI login
onboarding_profiles_lead_1: A profile is a colour-coded, isolated workspace — its own chats, tasks, memory, and files. Create one now (e.g.
onboarding_setup_lead: Give this profile a folder to work in and tell it what you'll use it for. Both are optional — you can change them anytime in Settings.
onboarding_folder_hint: the assistant gets read access — manage access later in Settings → Folders
onboarding_setup_empty_lead: No profiles to set up. Go back and create one first.
onboarding_ready_lead: Your preferences are saved to Settings. Let's get to work.
onboarding_not_connected: Not connected — add one in Settings → Models
onboarding_tip_1: Every action runs on the AG2 Stream — toggle
onboarding_connect_later: You can connect a model later in Settings → Models
settings_install_wide_title: Shared across every profile in this install
llm_env_note: These override the active configuration below until unset.
llm_empty: No configurations yet — add one below to connect a model.
llm_chip_claude_adapter_missing: Claude Code adapter not found — install claude-agent-acp
llm_chip_no_key: no key — pick a secret or set {env}
llm_delete_active_title: Deleting the active model falls back to the next one (or defaults)
llm_editing_title: Editing in progress — use the editor’s Test button to test your changes
llm_keyuse_subscription: Requests use your ChatGPT/Codex subscription — no API key is involved.
llm_keyuse_claude: Runs on your Claude Code CLI login (claude-agent-acp) — no API key is involved.
llm_keyuse_codex: Runs on your Codex CLI login (codex-acp) — no API key is involved.
llm_keyuse_ollama: Ollama is local — no API key is used.
llm_keyuse_new_secret: A new Secret will be created from this key on save (rename it later in Settings → Secrets).
llm_keyuse_secret_endpoint: Uses the "{name}" secret (sent to the custom endpoint). It overrides {env}.
llm_keyuse_secret_deleted: The referenced secret was deleted — falls back to the provider default or env key.
llm_keyuse_placeholder: Custom endpoint with no secret — a placeholder is sent (your {env} is never sent to non-{vendor} endpoints).
llm_keyuse_none: No key available — pick or paste one above, or set {env}.
llm_acp_adapter_missing: No model list: the ACP adapter isn't installed (npm i -g {pkg}). Leave the field empty to use the CLI's own model.
llm_acp_bridge: No model list in bridge mode — the CLI runs on the host, out of reach of this container. Leave the field empty to use the CLI's own model.
llm_acp_failed: Couldn't read the CLI's model list. Leave the field empty to use the CLI's own model, or type a name it accepts.
llm_adv_not_object: Advanced: must be a JSON object, e.g. {example}.
llm_api_interface_hint: which API surface this endpoint speaks
llm_base_url_hint: optional — naming your own endpoint is also how you choose the API interface it speaks
llm_sub_hint: Signs requests with your ChatGPT/Codex subscription instead of an API key — unofficial, may break OpenAI's Terms of Service.
llm_requires_adapter: Requires the {adapter} adapter on PATH ({cmd}) and a logged-in {cli} CLI.
llm_secret_hint: a reusable API key — manage in Settings → Secrets
llm_no_secret_option: No secret — provider default / env key
llm_paste_key_placeholder: …or paste a new key to create a secret
llm_secret_missing: This model referenced a deleted secret.
llm_provider_tools_hint: what {name} can do on its own servers
llm_adv_placeholder:
Extra AG2 provider-config settings as a JSON object, e.g.
{example}
live_empty: No live models yet — add one below to talk to the assistant.
live_click_to_use: Click to use this live model
live_delete_active_title: Deleting the active live model falls back to the next one (or legacy)
live_model_hint: realtime model — leave blank for the provider default
secrets_lead: Named, reusable API keys. Attach one to any Text or Live model; mark a provider-tagged secret as its provider's default fallback. Values are never shown back — only the last 4 characters.
secrets_empty: No secrets yet — add one below, or paste a key in a model form.
secrets_value_hint: leave blank to keep the current key
secrets_provider_hint: optional — groups the picker; required to be a default
skills_lead: Turn a skill off to drop it from the agent's toolkit everywhere, without deleting it. Bundled skills ship with the app and can't be removed.
skills_profile_lead: Skills this profile can use. Turn an inherited skill off for just this profile, or disable one it owns — other profiles are unaffected.
skills_this_profile_lead: Skills installed directly into this profile. Turn one off or delete it — only this profile is affected.
skills_profile_empty: No skills installed in this profile yet.
skills_global_bundled_lead: Shared skills inherited from the app. Turn one off to drop it from just this profile.
skills_profile_turn_on_title: Click to turn on for this profile
skills_profile_turn_off_title: Click to turn off for this profile
skills_off_appwide_title: Disabled for the whole app in Application → Skills
skills_choose_file: Choose a .md file or zipped skill folder…
integrations_google_note: Gmail, Calendar and Drive tools appear once you are signed in. Managing it opens the Google flow — Settings closes behind it.
integrations_github_disconnect_confirm: Disconnect GitHub? Skill downloads fall back to the anonymous rate limit.
integrations_empty: Nothing connected yet — add one below.
integrations_name_hint: Yours, not the platform's — it is how this connection is listed. Rename it any time.
integrations_secrets_note: Written to the secrets store and never shown to the browser again.
integrations_token_set_when: token set when this connection was made
integrations_token_replaced: Token replaced — the connection restarted on it.
integrations_replace_hint: Replacing keeps this connection's paired accounts, group pins and profile settings — right for a rotated token, wrong for a different bot, which belongs in its own integration.
integrations_disconnect_confirm: Disconnect {name}? Its paired accounts, group pins and default profile go with it. Every other connection is left running.
integrations_groups_lead: A group's profile is set here, not from the group — anyone in it can read the answers.
integrations_group_unreachable: not reachable here — this group is silent until it is re-pointed
integrations_pairing_lead: Only these accounts reach {name}. Pairing one here grants it nothing on any other connection, including another bot of the same kind.
integrations_code_send: Send {code} to this bot from the account you want to pair — {expiry}.
integrations_nobody_paired: Nobody is paired — this connection answers nobody.
integrations_pending_title: Pins to the first account that presents it
integrations_profiles_lead: Every profile is reachable through this connection until you turn it off; a conversation already sitting in a withdrawn one is told, not moved. The default is where a new conversation lands when nothing else has been chosen.
integrations_withdrawn_title: Withdrawn from every surface — it cannot be the default
integrations_clear_default_title: Leave this connection with no default
integrations_withdrawn_hint: A greyed-out profile is withdrawn from every surface here, so it cannot be the default.
integrations_no_default_warn: No default — a conversation that has not been pointed anywhere is refused.
profiles_lead: Manage how the assistant behaves in different contexts.
profile_focus_hint: What this profile is for — shapes how the assistant helps.
folders_hint: Folders this profile may reach outside its default workspace
folders_empty: This profile has no folders yet — add one to give it access.
profile_memory_hint: What this profile has learned about you.
profile_memory_placeholder: Preferences and context for this persona only…
profile_memory_empty_body: The assistant will gradually learn preferences and context specific to this profile as you chat. You can also add notes yourself.
profile_text_model_sub: Drives chat replies for this profile.
profile_voice_model_sub: Used when you talk to this profile out loud.
profile_text_switcher_title: Text model for this profile — takes effect next message
profile_voice_switcher_title: Voice model for this profile — takes effect next voice session
advanced_timeout_invalid: Chat turn timeout must be greater than zero.
advanced_turn_timeout_sub: Total time for model calls, tools, and questions
advanced_identity_hint: Identity facts — name, location, timezone, family, writing voice — that are true no matter which profile you're in. Shared across every profile.
advanced_ag2_sub: the AG2 primitives behind this app
advanced_ag2_view: AG2 view — reveal live AG2 events + per-item provenance
